output.summary: The function fn_02 computes a hash value using a polynomial and returns it.

claims.text: The function iterates over each byte in the input buffer.
The function multiplies the hash value by 0x100000001b3 in each iteration.
The function XORs the hash value with the current byte in each iteration.
The function returns the computed hash value.
